project_info.theme: Banana shake nutrition and recipe card
project_info.color_palette: Cream white, banana yellow, soft gold, pale olive, warm brown

main_subject.detail: A realistic creamy banana shake in a footed glass with whipped cream, sliced banana garnish and a striped straw, centered on a soft paper-textured background.
main_subject.style: Premium recipe-book food infographic with semi-3D icons and soft rounded cards

composition_elements.text: Banana Shake; Nutrition; Steps; Health Benefits; 5 MINUTES; SERVES 1
items: Center: banana shake hero glass with banana slices and cream.
Left: stacked nutrition cards for calories, protein, carbs, fats, fiber, potassium, vitamin B6, calcium and magnesium.
Right upper: Blend, Adjust Thickness and Chill & Pour recipe steps.
Right lower: health-benefit card including energy, recovery, gut, bone and mood support.
Bottom: time, serving and sweetness controls.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm creamy highlights, light paper grain, subtle shadows and readable balanced card spacing

assets.name: drink recipe and hero styling
assets.source: verified recipe and approved food reference
assets.usage: Preserve ingredient list, glass, garnish and actual serving appearance.

assets.name: nutrition and health data
assets.source: verified nutrition database or dietitian-approved data
assets.usage: Populate calories, macros, micronutrients and health statements accurately.

assets.name: recipe-card typography and icon layout
assets.usage: Keep all cards, titles, icons and step hierarchy readable.

prompt_instructions: Do not invent nutritional claims or values; attach a verified data sheet.
Use one drink recipe per card and preserve metric units.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clean, modern food infographic poster for [DRINK NAME], centered composition. A highly realistic glass/bottle of the drink in the middle with smooth texture, condensation, and soft studio lighting. Minimal pastel background with subtle paper texture. Surrounding the drink are neatly arranged UI-style information cards and icons showing nutrition facts, preparation steps, time, servings, sweetness level, and health benefits. Rounded cards, soft shadows, warm color palette matching the drink, flat + semi-3D icon design. Elegant typography, premium recipe-book aesthetic, Pinterest/Instagram infographic style, ultra-sharp, balanced spacing, professional food design, high detail, 8K quality.
prompt.negative_prompt: unverified nutrition data, unreadable cards, wrong ingredient, cluttered layout, misleading health claim, low resolution, watermark
